name: Careful Spell
effect: Increase the action cost of the spell by 1.

name: Channeled Spell
effect: Reduce the mana cost of the spell by an amount equal to its rank × your WIL.

name: Close-range Cast
effect:
You cast the spell in a way that weaves it into the flow of combat.
Adjacent creatures take a -1 penalty on their saving throws against the spell instead of a +2 bonus.

name: Distant Spell
effect:
Double the range of the spell.
If the spell has a range of touch, it instead has a range of 3 tiles.

name: Empowered Spell
effect:
Increase the power of the spell.
Add your INT (or WIL if cast as an Attuned Spell) to the first damage roll of the spell.

name: Expand Spell
effect: Increase the amount of the radius or width the spell effects by one tile.

name: Focused Spell
effect: Spend 1 Focus point.

name: Fuel Spell
effect:
Increase the number of dice dealt by the spell by one.
You take half the damage of that extra die as Vital damage.

name: Obscure Spell
effect:
You weave the mana in an unorthodox fashion for the spell, giving any attempts to Identify it a -5 penalty.
Alternatively, you may attempt to make the spell appear as another spell you are trained in.

name: Recolor Spell
effect:
Add flair to spell, with a splash of color. 
You can give the spell any color you want, though you can't make it look like another spell.

name: Sculpted Spell
effect:
Choose one creature in the area of the spell to not be affected by it.
You may choose more than one creature, increasing the Spellshaping DC by 1 for each extra creature.

name: Tracing Spell
effect:
You attach a thread of mana to the target with the spell.
If the target is in range of a mana thread, attach one.

name: Armor Breaking Spell
effect:
You infuse the spell with more force to overwhelm and shatter armor.
The instant damage done by the spell ignores resistance equal to its rank + your INT (or WIL if cast as an Attuned Spell).

name: Elemental Shift
effect: Shift the spell's damage type to an aspect you have the Basic Elemental Magic feat with.

name: Homing Spell
effect:
Increase the initial Save of the spell by 3. 
Additionally, the spell ignores lesser cover.

name: Quick Spell
effect: Reduce the action cost of the spell by 1 (minimum one action).

name: Running Cast
effect:
You cast the spell on the move, weaving the spell mid-motion.
Stride or Traverse, then cast the spell at any point during the movement.

name: Sustaining Spell
effect: For the first three turns, the spell sustains itself and needs no action from you.

name: Overchannel Spell
effect:
Overchannel a spell to levels beyond those you would normally be capable of.
Upcast the spell to one rank higher than your current highest rank.
Afterwards, you gain one level of Mana Poisoning.

name: Forceful Spell
effect:
Infuse some more force into the spell.
In addition to the other effects of the spell, one creature hit by it falls prone or is pushed back 2 tiles (your choice).

name: Resistant Spell
effect:
Weave the spell in a way that makes it hard for others to disrupt.
Any attempts to Spellbreak, Unweave, or otherwise magically disrupt the spell have disadvantage.

name: Ride the Lightning
effect: You move to any location the spell hits.

name: Twin Spell
effect:
Cast the spell at two targets within range, using the same Spellshaping roll for both.
This gives the spell the Draining trait.

name: Compressed Spell
effect:
Instead of being cast immediately, the spell is prepared and stored in a dimensional bubble.
It can be released later as a reaction to any trigger.
At the end of each turn you hold a Compressed Spell, you pay a third of its mana cost or it casts automatically, centered on you.
